mnemonic.meaning: 学 study + 習 learn: studying and learning.
mnemonic.reading: "GAKU, SHUU!" (がくしゅう) Gak, shoes on, time to study.

examples.ja: 毎日少しずつ日本語を学習している。
examples.en: I study Japanese a little every day.

items.note: Formal. 勉強 is everyday. 学習者 = learner.

mnemonic.meaning: 見 see + 当 hit: seeing where it will hit.
mnemonic.reading: "KEN, TOU!" (けんとう) Ken's toe points in the right direction. Note: 見 is けん here.

examples.ja: 彼がどこにいるか、全く見当がつかない。
examples.en: I have no idea where he is.

items.note: 見当がつく = to have an idea. 見当違い = off the mark.

mnemonic.meaning: 借 borrow: what you borrowed.
mnemonic.reading: "KARI!" (かり) From 借りる (to borrow).

examples.ja: 彼には借りがある。
examples.en: I owe him one.

items.note: 借りを返す = to repay a favour. 貸し = what you lent.

mnemonic.meaning: 休 rest + 息 breath: rest and catch your breath.
mnemonic.reading: "KYUU, SOKU!" (きゅうそく) Same sound as 急速 (Level 12).

examples.ja: 十分な休息をとってください。
examples.en: Please get enough rest.

items.note: Formal. 休憩 (Level 1) is a short break. 休み is everyday.

mnemonic.meaning: 祝 has 礻 (altar): celebrating at the altar.
mnemonic.reading: "IWAI!" (いわい) From 祝う (to celebrate).

examples.ja: 友達の結婚のお祝いを買った。
examples.en: I bought a wedding present for my friend.

items.note: Usually お祝い: a celebration or a gift for it.

mnemonic.meaning: 年 years + 月 months: years and months.
mnemonic.reading: "TOSHI, TSUKI!" (としつき) Years (年, とし) and months (月, つき). Also read ねんげつ.

examples.ja: 長い年月が過ぎた。
examples.en: Many long years have passed.

items.note: Literary. Also read ねんげつ with the same meaning.

mnemonic.meaning: 癌 has 疒 (sickness): a serious illness.
mnemonic.reading: "GAN!" (がん) A gun-shot of bad news.

examples.ja: 祖父は癌で入院している。
examples.en: My grandfather is in hospital with cancer.

items.note: Often written in katakana: ガン or がん.

mnemonic.meaning: 賞 has 貝 (money/shell): a valuable reward.
mnemonic.reading: "SHOU!" (しょう) Show off your prize.

examples.ja: 彼女は絵のコンクールで賞を取った。
examples.en: She won a prize in an art contest.

items.note: ノーベル賞 = Nobel Prize. 賞金 = prize money.

mnemonic.meaning: 広 wide: make it wide.
mnemonic.reading: "HIRO, MERU!" (ひろめる) Hiro mails it to everyone.

examples.ja: 日本の文化を世界に広めたい。
examples.en: I want to spread Japanese culture around the world.

items.note: Transitive partner of 広まる (Level 13).

mnemonic.meaning: 片 piece + 付 attach: pieces attached back in place.
mnemonic.reading: "KATA, ZUKU!" (かたづく) Shoulders (肩) relax once it's tidy.

examples.ja: 部屋がやっと片付いた。
examples.en: The room is finally tidy.

items.note: Intransitive. 片付ける = you tidy it. Also 仕事が片付く (work gets done).

mnemonic.meaning: 害 = a lid on a mouth (口): words that cut and harm.
mnemonic.reading: "GAI!" (がい) The guy did harm.

examples.ja: タバコは体に害がある。
examples.en: Smoking is harmful to your health.

items.note: 害虫 = pest, 被害 = damage.

mnemonic.meaning: 畳 = tatami mat: something folded and stacked.
mnemonic.reading: "TATAMU!" (たたむ) Fold it like a tatami (たたみ).

examples.ja: 洗濯物を畳んだ。
examples.en: I folded the laundry.

items.note: 店を畳む = to close a shop for good.

mnemonic.meaning: 読 read: a reading.
mnemonic.reading: "YOMI!" (よみ) From 読む.

examples.ja: この漢字の読みを教えてください。
examples.en: Please tell me the reading of this kanji.

items.note: Also a prediction: 読みが当たる (your guess is right).

mnemonic.meaning: 見 see + 解 explain: how you see and explain it.
mnemonic.reading: "KEN, KAI!" (けんかい) Ken and Kai share their views.

examples.ja: 専門家の見解を聞きたい。
examples.en: I'd like to hear an expert's view.

items.note: Formal; official opinions. 意見 is everyday.

mnemonic.meaning: 適 suitable: to be suitable.
mnemonic.reading: "TEKI, SURU!" (てきする) Take it, sir: it fits.

examples.ja: この土地は米作りに適している。
examples.en: This land is suitable for growing rice.

items.note: Usually 〜に適している. Formal.

mnemonic.meaning: 当 hit: a hit.
mnemonic.reading: "ATARI!" (あたり) Same sound as 辺り (vicinity).

examples.ja: このくじは当たりだ。
examples.en: This lottery ticket is a winner.

items.note: Also "per": 一人当たり (per person). 当たり前 = natural, obvious.

mnemonic.meaning: GUSSURI: "Goo-soo-ree," snoring soundly.

examples.ja: 昨夜はぐっすり眠った。
examples.en: I slept soundly last night.

items.note: Almost always with sleeping: ぐっすり寝る / 眠る.

mnemonic.meaning: 大 big + 部分 part: the big part.
mnemonic.reading: "DAI, BUBUN!" (だいぶぶん) The big portion.

examples.ja: 仕事の大部分は終わった。
examples.en: Most of the work is done.

items.note: Close to 大半 (Level 10) and ほとんど.

mnemonic.meaning: 頂 summit + 上 top: the very top.
mnemonic.reading: "CHOU, JOU!" (ちょうじょう) Chew gum, Joe, we're at the top.

examples.ja: 山の頂上から日の出を見た。
examples.en: I watched the sunrise from the mountain top.

items.note: 頂上 = peak of a mountain, or a summit meeting (頂上会談).

mnemonic.meaning: 年 year + 代 generation: a span of years.
mnemonic.reading: "NEN, DAI!" (ねんだい) Nen's decade.

examples.ja: 九十年代の音楽が好きだ。
examples.en: I like music from the nineties.

items.note: 〜年代 = decade. Also age group: 同じ年代 (the same generation).

mnemonic.meaning: 参 participate + 考 think: things that take part in your thinking.
mnemonic.reading: "SAN, KOU!" (さんこう) Three (三) cows for reference.

examples.ja: 先輩の意見を参考にした。
examples.en: I took my senior's opinion into account.

items.note: 参考にする = use as a reference. 参考書 = study guide.

mnemonic.meaning: 公 fair + 平 even: fair and even.
mnemonic.reading: "KOU, HEY!" (こうへい) Hey, be fair.

examples.ja: 先生は全員を公平に扱った。
examples.en: The teacher treated everyone fairly.

items.note: 不公平 = unfair. 平等 (Level 15) = equal.

mnemonic.meaning: 汲 has 氵 (water): drawing water.
mnemonic.reading: "KUMU!" (くむ) Same sound as 組む (Level 5).

examples.ja: 井戸から水を汲んだ。
examples.en: I drew water from the well.

items.note: Figurative: 気持ちを汲む (take someone's feelings into account).

mnemonic.meaning: 克 overcome + 服 obey: make it obey you.
mnemonic.reading: "KOKU, FUKU!" (こくふく) A coke on your clothes: get over it.

examples.ja: 彼は病気を克服した。
examples.en: He overcame his illness.

items.note: For difficulties, fears, illness: 苦手を克服する.

mnemonic.meaning: 見 see + 送 send: seeing someone off.
mnemonic.reading: "MI, OKURI!" (みおくり) Seeing (見) someone sent (送り) off.

examples.ja: 空港まで友達の見送りに行った。
examples.en: I went to the airport to see my friend off.

items.note: Also shelving a plan: 計画は見送りになった.

mnemonic.meaning: 乾 dry + 燥 dry up: very dry.
mnemonic.reading: "KAN, SOU!" (かんそう) Same sound as 感想 (impressions).

examples.ja: 冬は空気が乾燥している。
examples.en: The air is dry in winter.

items.note: 乾燥機 = dryer. 乾く is everyday "to dry".

mnemonic.meaning: 適 suitable + 度 degree: a suitable degree.
mnemonic.reading: "TEKI, DO!" (てきど) Take it, but do it in moderation.

examples.ja: 適度な運動は健康にいい。
examples.en: Moderate exercise is good for your health.

items.note: Not too much, not too little. 過度 (かど) = excessive.

mnemonic.meaning: 弱 weak: it becomes weaker.
mnemonic.reading: "YOWA, MARU!" (よわまる) The round storm weakens.

examples.ja: 台風の勢いが弱まった。
examples.en: The typhoon has weakened.

items.note: Intransitive. 弱める = you weaken it. 強まる (Level 18) is the opposite.

mnemonic.meaning: 泊 has 氵 (water): a boat at harbour overnight. Letting someone stay.
mnemonic.reading: "TOMERU!" (とめる) Same sound as 止める and 留める (Level 13).

examples.ja: 友達を一晩泊めた。
examples.en: I put my friend up for the night.

items.note: Transitive. 泊まる = to stay overnight.

mnemonic.meaning: 同 same + 一 one: one and the same.
mnemonic.reading: "DOU, ITSU!" (どういつ) Dough, it's the same.

examples.ja: 二つの事件は同一人物によるものだ。
examples.en: The two incidents were committed by the same person.

items.note: Formal; 同じ is everyday.
